name: Sigmund Freud
shortBio: Austrian neurologist and founder of psychoanalysis; pioneered theories of the dynamic unconscious, infantile sexuality, repression, and dream analysis.
centralQuestion: How do repressed instinctual drives in the unconscious manifest in neuroses, dreams, culture, and the discontents of civilization?

keyWorks.title: The Interpretation of Dreams
keyWorks.description: Foundational psychoanalytic text introducing dream censorship and wish-fulfillment.

keyWorks.title: The Ego and the Id
keyWorks.description: Introduces the structural model of the psyche: id, ego, and super-ego.

keyWorks.title: Civilization and Its Discontents
keyWorks.description: Analyzes the fundamental clash between instinctual desires and societal sublimation.
